description: This file defines a PHP trait 'NestedSetTrait' that provides a method to fetch a hierarchical tree structure from a database, using Doctrine ORM. It includes logic to ensure the calling class implements the required interface and constructs a query with optional depth filtering.

methods.name: fetchTree
methods.description: Retrieves a tree of nested set entities, optionally limited by depth. Checks if the class implements the NestedSetInterface, then constructs and executes a Doctrine query to fetch the hierarchical data.
